links.outcome: Readability of LLM responses on pediatric phimosis (Gunning-Fog, SMOG, Dale-Chall)
links.effect: Mean Gunning-Fog 14.2 ± 2.6, SMOG 11.3 ± 2.2, Dale-Chall 9.9 ± 0.9; comprehension rated difficult; no significant readability differences across the three LLMs.
links.quote: Comprehension of the information was considered difficult with a mean Gunning-Fog score, SMOG index score and Dale-Chall score of 14.2 ± 2.6, 11.3 ± 2.2 and 9.9 ± 0.9, respectively.

screen.reason: Evaluates commercial LLM responses (accuracy, readability, and DISCERN quality) to pediatric phimosis questions without testing specific deployment practices or organizational safeguards.
